title: Collecting staff jackets
passage: If you are working at the exhibition this weekend, collect your jacket from the staff entrance on Friday. We have placed each ordered jacket in a bag with the worker’s name on it. Try on your jacket before you leave. If you need a different size, take the bag it came in to the fitting desk. The jackets for the evening crew have red tags. They are not spare jackets. The fitting desk has a separate supply, but there are no jackets in size XL today. If you need that size, leave your name. We’ll check the next delivery on Saturday morning.
passageZh: 本週末會到展覽工作的人員，請於週五到員工入口領取外套。我們已把每件訂好的外套裝袋，並在袋上寫了工作人員的名字。離開前請先試穿外套。如果需要換尺寸，請把原本裝外套的袋子帶到試穿櫃檯。晚班人員的外套有紅色標籤。這些外套不是備用品。試穿櫃檯另有一批外套，但今天沒有 XL（加大）尺寸的備品。如果你需要這個尺寸，請留下名字；我們會在週六早上查看下一批到貨有沒有這個尺寸。
